title: Narrow the production deploy role like staging
description:
As the owner, I want the production deploy role scoped to least privilege like staging and development, so that a compromised workflow cannot administer the account.

The production deploy role remains AdministratorAccess. The repo template change (additive denies) is already merged but the deployed ChatticusAccountDeploy production stack was deliberately NOT touched. Owner rule: never apply without his explicit go. Apply in a window, with workflow proofs (production deploy workflows and smoke tests green afterwards).

Feature: Least-privilege production deploy role
  Scenario: Production deploys after narrowing
    Given the owner has approved the change window
    When the production account deploy stack is applied
    Then the production deploy workflows and smoke tests pass
    And the role no longer carries AdministratorAccess
